description: Dispatch: an idle experienced worker takes a task before an idle inexperienced one.
Move one inexperienced worker from area AB to area CD all day (CD serves about 57% of customers).
Peak hours (11:30-14:00, 18:00-20:00): 4 experienced + 1 inexperienced per area instead of 3 + 3.
Close line D 14:00-18:00; its cashier is unpaid while closed.
Close line B 14:00-18:00; its cashier is unpaid while closed.
Second cashier at line C in peak hours, paid for by the a03 peak staff mix (4 exp + 1 inexp).
Second cashier at lines B, C, D in peak hours; peak staff 2 exp + 2 inexp per area.
Second cashier at all four lines in peak hours; peak staff 2+2, off-peak 2 exp + 1 inexp per area.
Second cashier at lines B, C, D all day; peak staff 2+2, off-peak 1+1 per area.
Staff cut only (no other change): peak 2+2, off-peak 1+1 per area.
